manifest.annotation: # pragma: allowlist secret -- verified original evidence digest

packaging: Sorted basename-only regular USTAR members, mode 0644, zero owner IDs and timestamps; gzip mtime zero. Archive metadata is normalized, not an observation timestamp.
provenance: Exact original provider responses and task-local artifacts named in the unchanged historical manifest. No member bytes were rewritten or redacted. Historical session-local role descriptions remain in that manifest; this archive supplies their later retention.
limits: Byte identity is not semantic validation or proof of an exhaustive provider history. The retained preparation script is historical evidence, not a supported command and must not be executed as part of verification.
